headers.subject: Delivery Update: Address Clarification Needed (Site Mail)

body_text:
Hello,
A shipment arrived at the main receiving dock, but the internal mail stop/site code on the label is incomplete. If you’re expecting a package delivered this week, please reply with your building number and mail stop so Receiving can route it correctly.
Alternatively, you can update your delivery details here: https://receiving.nebulon[.]com/package-update
Thanks,
Receiving
